scope: Retrospective choice of an unchanged pre-existing adaptive algorithm after internally known fixed-weight results; independent materials not involved in its original settings.
optimizer: src/coarse.py::Coarse.optimize, same hard objective, chart, rescue and tie break as src/propose.py gradient1
selection: Select only completed evaluations at elapsed wall <=1s, pay any completed overrun; no data-dependent time extension or frequency/weight changes.
physical_normalization: Both 64 entries of the two coarse weight arrays mapped to native by binary64 /9, exact native 96² operators
primary: src/score_batch.py evaluate with 256-tile Arb upper screen and Native strict score, no coarse inertia hint
recovery: src/recover_unknown.py eligible and examine, once on primary unresolved cases; retain all first and recovered receipts
control: FIVE archived same-cap fixed profiles, already scored on exactly these data in transferred_weight_transfer16.json; compare using exact same Y/radius, no recomputation.
labels: Optimizer and strict verifiers read only Y, radius and opaque IDs. Scalar cap labels only after all adaptive scores exist.
decision: PASS iff lower > radius; verified below-or-equal when upper <= radius; otherwise UNKNOWN.
analysis: Record paired changes and uncertainty by view/noise and by independent distinct objects. Record all task scopes and actual costs.
